meta.notes: Two independent branches. (A) Weekly evaluation: every Monday 08:00 the golden question set is asked in Agentic mode, each answer is scored (answer present, at least one source, coverage report present) and the summary is emailed. Connect your Gmail credential on the email node after import and set the recipient. (B) Report delivery: POST /webhook/msrag-report with JSON {"question": "..."} fetches the backend Markdown report for that question and returns it; this is the hook other tools (Drive export, email) attach to. The backend generates reports; n8n only schedules, evaluates and delivers.

name: MS RAG Studio - 03 Reports and weekly evaluation
